description: Consolidate the mapped residue panel, gatekeeper charge test, counterexamples and GO decision into artifact tables, and render the final computed summary figure
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# Values below are carried from the mapping cells run earlier in this session
# (sequence NW mapping + Kabsch structural mapping onto PDB 6NO0 chain A, 48/48 agreement).
panel = pd.DataFrame([
 # label, uniprot, measured specificity, b20(contact), b111, b113, b227, b46(GATE1), b114(GATE2)
 ("Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)","P53590","GTP-specific (measured)","Q58","E145","L147","F257","E80","D148"),
 ("Human SUCLG2 (G-type)","Q96I99","GTP-specific (measured)","Q57","E144","L146","F256","E79","D147"),
 ("T. aquaticus SCS beta","3UFX:B","GDP/GTP-preferring (measured)","P20","?","?","?","R41","D95"),
 ("E. coli SucC","P0A836","dual, ADP/ATP-preferring (measured)","P20","A100","T102","L212","P42","D103"),
 ("Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)","O97580","ATP-specific (measured)","P34","E121","R123","M233","D56","Y124"),
 ("Human SUCLA2 (A-type)","Q9P2R7","ATP-specific (measured)","P72","E159","K161","M271","D94","Y162"),
 ("Blastocystis SCS-beta","B3FHP0","ATP-specific (measured)","Q34","G125","V127","L241","K60","K128"),
 ("A. ambigua SUCLG2 TARGET","A0A9P6TY68","NOT MEASURED","Q34","E121","L123","F233","E56","D124"),
 ("A. ambigua TCA9 (A-type)","A0A9P6Q632","NOT MEASURED","P48","E135","K137","M247","D70","Y138"),
], columns=["protein","accession","measured_specificity","b20_contact","b111","b113","b227","b46_GATE1","b114_GATE2"])

# distance of each mapped position to the bound ADP in 6NO0 chain A (measured earlier, side-chain min distance)
dist = {"b20_contact":1.77,"b113":2.50,"b227":2.94,"b111":4.66,"b114_GATE2":5.21,"b46_GATE1":6.98}
print("=== TABLE 1. residue panel at the mapped positions ===")
print(panel.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmin side-chain distance to bound ADP in 6NO0 chain A (Angstrom):")
for k,v in sorted(dist.items(), key=lambda x:x[1]): print(f"  {k:14s} {v:.2f}")

# Does a basic residue at either gatekeeper track measured specificity?
meas = panel[panel.measured_specificity.str.contains("measured")].copy()
meas["class"] = np.where(meas.measured_specificity.str.startswith(("GTP","GDP")),"GTP-side","ATP-side")
print("\n=== TABLE 2. gatekeeper charge class vs measured specificity ===")
rows=[]
for col in ["b46_GATE1","b114_GATE2","b20_contact"]:
    meas[col+"_basic"] = meas[col].str[0].isin(["K","R","H"])
    a=((meas["class"]=="GTP-side")&meas[col+"_basic"]).sum(); b=((meas["class"]=="GTP-side")&~meas[col+"_basic"]).sum()
    c=((meas["class"]=="ATP-side")&meas[col+"_basic"]).sum(); d=((meas["class"]=="ATP-side")&~meas[col+"_basic"]).sum()
    orr,p = fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
    rows.append(dict(position=col, GTPside_basic=f"{a}/{a+b}", ATPside_basic=f"{c}/{c+d}",
                     fisher_p=round(p,3), separates="NO"))
    print(f"  {col:14s} basic in GTP-side {a}/{a+b}, in ATP-side {c}/{c+d}, Fisher p={p:.3f}")
gk=pd.DataFrame(rows)

print("\n=== TABLE 3. counterexamples that break each signal ===")
ce = pd.DataFrame([
 ("b46 GATE1","basic residue should mark the ATP-specific enzyme",
  "T. aquaticus has Arg41 and prefers GDP/GTP; pig and human SUCLA2 are ATP-specific with Asp"),
 ("b114 GATE2","basic residue should mark the ATP-specific enzyme",
  "only Blastocystis is basic (Lys128); all three other ATP-side enzymes carry Asp or Tyr"),
 ("b20 contact Gln","Gln should mark GTP specificity",
  "Gln20 is present in ATP-specific Blastocystis; Pro20 is present in both ATP-preferring E. coli and GDP/GTP-preferring T. aquaticus"),
 ("bulk charge 8-15 A","negative environment should mark GTP",
  "T. aquaticus (GTP-side) net charge -1 at 12 A sits inside the ATP range; E. coli (ATP-side) base potential -2.33 is more negative than either GTP-specific enzyme"),
], columns=["signal","what it would have to do","observed counterexample"])
print(ce.to_string(index=False))

print("\n=== TABLE 4. GO decision table ===")
go = pd.DataFrame([
 ("GO:0004774","succinate-CoA ligase activity","MF","not currently on entry","ADD as the supported MF",
  "exact is_a parent of both child terms; defined on 'nucleotide triphosphate' without naming a base"),
 ("GO:0004775","succinate-CoA ligase (ADP-forming) activity","MF","IEA:UniProtKB-UniRule (HAMAP MF_03219)","FLAG for curator review / do not assert",
  "contradicted by the co-asserted GDP-forming term; no residue signal separates ADP from GDP"),
 ("GO:0004776","succinate-CoA ligase (GDP-forming) activity","MF","IEA:TreeGrafter (PANTHER PTHR11815:SF10)","FLAG for curator review / do not assert",
  "rests on G-type lineage membership, the inference the gap identifies as unsupported"),
 ("GO:0042709","succinate-CoA ligase complex","CC","IEA","RETAIN as lead",
  "alpha/beta heterodimer architecture is conserved and the genome encodes one alpha plus both betas"),
 ("GO:0006099","tricarboxylic acid cycle","BP","IEA","RETAIN as lead",
  "pathway membership does not depend on which nucleotide is used"),
 ("GO:0005739","mitochondrion","CC","IEA","RETAIN as lead, verify targeting peptide",
  "not tested here; Blastocystis SCS was localized to its mitochondrion-like organelle (PMID 18452512)"),
], columns=["GO_ID","term","aspect","current evidence on A0A9P6TY68","recommended action (lead)","basis"])
print(go.to_string(index=False))

panel.to_csv("TABLE1_residue_panel.csv",index=False)
gk.to_csv("TABLE2_gatekeeper_vs_specificity.csv",index=False)
ce.to_csv("TABLE3_counterexamples.csv",index=False)
go.to_csv("TABLE4_go_decision.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved TABLE1..TABLE4 csv")

# Final figure: the panel, coloured by measured specificity, ordered by distance to the nucleotide
order=["b20_contact","b113","b227","b111","b114_GATE2","b46_GATE1"]
fig,(axA,axB)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[3,1]})
cols={"GTP-specific (measured)":"#2f6fb5","GDP/GTP-preferring (measured)":"#5b9bd5",
      "dual, ADP/ATP-preferring (measured)":"#e08214","ATP-specific (measured)":"#c0392b","NOT MEASURED":"#999999"}
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(panel.iterrows()):
    for j,c in enumerate(order):
        v=r[c]; basic = v[0] in "KRH"
        axA.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j-0.5,i-0.5),1,1,facecolor="#f4d03f" if basic else "white",
                                    edgecolor="#cccccc"))
        axA.text(j,i,v,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                 fontweight="bold" if basic else "normal")
axA.set_xlim(-0.5,len(order)-0.5);axA.set_ylim(len(panel)-0.5,-0.5)
axA.set_xticks(range(len(order)))
axA.set_xticklabels([f"{c}\n{dist[c]:.1f} A" for c in order],fontsize=8)
axA.set_yticks(range(len(panel)))
axA.set_yticklabels(panel.protein,fontsize=9)
for t,(_,r) in zip(axA.get_yticklabels(),panel.iterrows()): t.set_color(cols[r.measured_specificity])
axA.set_title("Mapped residues, yellow = basic. Row colour = measured specificity\n"
              "(blue GTP side, orange dual, red ATP side, grey not measured)",fontsize=10)
axA.set_xlabel("position, with min side-chain distance to bound ADP in 6NO0")
x=[dist[c] for c in order]
axB.barh(range(len(order)),x,color=["#c0392b" if c in("b46_GATE1","b114_GATE2") else "#2f6fb5" for c in order])
axB.set_yticks(range(len(order)));axB.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=8);axB.invert_yaxis()
axB.axvline(4.0,ls="--",color="k",lw=1);axB.set_xlabel("distance to ADP (A)")
axB.set_title("red = proposed gatekeepers,\nboth outside contact range",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
